reporting-org.narrative: Digital Impact Alliance at Capital For Good

description.narrative:
This program drives learning and action alongside country and regional partners across Africa. Working hand-in-hand with governments and ecosystem actors, the team supports the co-creation of policies, strategies, and implementation pathways that translate people-centered data governance into practice. Our engagement model is grounded in national priorities and defined by trust and genuine thought partnership.
Through targeted use cases, institutional strengthening, and applied problem-solving, the team helps partners navigate the real trade-offs involved in designing systems that promote participation, agency, choice, and trust while enhancing national development. This includes engaging actors across government, private sector, and civil society to ensure solutions reflect diverse perspectives and lived realities. Just as importantly, the team captures and documents locally led models and practical lessons that can inform others across the continent and beyond.
